chunks: Ja'far ibn Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abdullah ibn al-Mughira al-Kufi narrated to us, saying: My grandfather al-Hasan ibn Ali narrated to me, from Amr ibn Uthman al-Thaqafi, from Sa'id ibn Sharhabil, from Ibn Lahiya, from Abu Malik, who said: I asked Ali ibn al-Hussein (peace be upon them both): Inform me of all the rules of the religion.
He said: Speaking the truth, ruling with justice, and fulfilling the pledge.
ai.seo_question: What are the three main rules of the religion according to Imam Ali ibn al-Hussein?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Khisal*, this hadith traces its chain back to Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (Zayn al-Abidin), emphasizing that the entirety of Sharia can be distilled into truthfulness, justice, and covenant-keeping. This triad reflects the Shia emphasis on *adl* (justice) and *amanah* (trustworthiness) as the practical manifestations of faith, linking ethical behavior directly to spiritual integrity.
